name: caption-clip-wipe
title: Clip Wipe
description: Reel captions on a black rounded plate: the whole line waits in muted grey and each word is wiped over from left to right as it is spoken, lands in the red accent and settles to ink. All words and timings come in one variable; mount over the whole frame for the speech.

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Every caption word with its timing, in order: word|start|end separated by ; (seconds from mount start, e.g. Такой|0.20|0.48;монтаж|0.48|0.90). Build it from transcript.json words.
